name: Alejandro Arellano Cedillo
summary:
Alejandro Arellano Cedillo is a Spanish Catholic cleric, professor and jurist who has been the Dean of the Roman Rota since March 2021. Studied for priesthood at Instituto Teológico San Ildefonso and subsequently ordained on 25 October 1987 in Toledo, he has obtained a Licentiate and Doctorate in Canon Law from the Pontifical Gregorian University.

He was deputy judicial vicar in the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Madrid and judge in the Tribunal of the Rota of the Apostolic Nunciature to Spain. He is a professor of Canon Law and Jurisprudence. Alejandro Arellano Cedillo was a religious figures from Olías del Rey (b. 1962-06-08, Olías del Rey). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
